environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed behind API Gateway (REST API, regional endpoint) with Lambda proxy integration. The Lambda function has an execution role with VPC access (attached to private subnets with NAT gateway). No CloudFront distribution in front. API Gateway endpoint is publicly accessible at https://abc123.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/prod/. The Lambda security group allows all outbound traffic (0.0.0.0/0 on all ports). EC2 instance metadata service (IMDSv1) is accessible from within the VPC. No WAF rules attached to the API Gateway stage.
